heading: Generic errors
text:
### Generic errors [IERR.2.3]

**Reserved, never reused: -6**, with -105
([IERR.2.4]) and -603. A schema reaches an engine only from its one artefact
([NFCT.1.1]), so no public call or load registers a duplicate or an invalid
slot marker, and a clone copies what the load accepted ([IARC.11.1]). Each
code has no public producer ([IERR.2.8a]).
